counterfactual_missing_items: No clear mention of malignant characteristics
No clear mention of other tumor types being ruled out
decisive_items: Image Description: A 35 × 9 mm sized mass occupying the spinal canal at T8-T9 level.
Immunohistochemical analysis: Neoplastic cells were negative for epithelial membrane antigen, pancytokeratin and desmin but diffuse positive for protein S-100.
response.rationale: The champion and runner-up both suggest a diagnosis of schwannoma, but R2 provides more comprehensive support from imaging and immunohistochemical analysis, while C1 provides more specific anatomical information.

rejected.why: While C1 provides more specific anatomical information, it is an append-only completion of R2 and does not provide sufficient independent evidence to be considered the champion.
